Folks, we need to wake up to what is really happening on our streets. The radical organizers behind these so-called protests want us to swallow the narrative that 8 million Americans are rising up in a grand, unified resistance, mobilized across all 50 US states at more than 3,300 events. That is the claim coming straight from the organizers themselves. They are boasting about "about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October," all while complaining that authorities are refusing to give them an official count. 

Let's call this what it is: progressive agitators and radical groups pushing an agenda of institutional destruction under the guise of grassroots activism. Instead of respecting traditional authority, social order, and the rule of law, they are out demanding "institutional reform" and equity—which are just code words for tearing down the foundational pillars of our republic. AFP might confirm that these events are sweeping the nation, but what we are actually witnessing is an assault on our national stability and the traditional values that keep our families and communities secure. It is time to push back against these mobs and stand up for real order and leadership.
